newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Mobil Coryton tanker berth damaged by VLCC.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Mobil Coryton tanker berth damaged by VLCC.

text.p: A tanker berth at the Mobil's U.K. refinery of Coryton will be out of action for some days after a very large crude carrier was blown into it on 40 knot gust of wind, the Port of London Authority (PLA) said on Monday.
The 279,994 dwt Hellespont Paradise was unable to discharge its cargo at the Thames port on February 27 and sailed to Europoort in the Netherlands, a PLA official said.
Lloyds Casualty quoted the PLA as saying the berth would not be fully operational again until next week as parts had to be ordered from the Netherlands, but a PLA official was unable to confirm this.
